overview: MENASCO delivered the mechanical, electrical and plumbing (MEP) scope for Vela by Omniyat, one of Dubai’s most prestigious ultra-luxury waterfront residential developments. Located in one of Dubai’s most sought-after destinations, the development combines timeless architecture with advanced building technologies to deliver an exclusive lifestyle experience.

Our engineering team coordinated these systems end-to-end, from concept through installation, testing and commissioning, delivering integrated solutions that support outstanding performance, sustainability, efficiency, and long-term reliability.

The development incorporates intelligent building technologies, environmentally responsible engineering solutions, and premium life-safety systems that align with Omniyat’s vision of creating iconic, future-ready properties. Through Vela by Omniyat, MENASCO continues to demonstrate its expertise in delivering complex, high-end MEP solutions for some of the region’s most prestigious developments.

contribution.heading: MENASCO’s Engineering Contribution
contribution.body: MENASCO delivered the complete MEP scope for Vela by Omniyat, engineering the mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire protection, and life-safety systems behind one of Dubai’s most iconic waterfront addresses, and reinforcing our reputation for engineering excellence on landmark developments.

outcome: The project was delivered with exceptional engineering precision, supporting Omniyat’s vision of timeless luxury and architectural excellence. MENASCO successfully implemented high-performance MEP systems that provide superior occupant comfort, operational reliability, sustainability, and long-term value.

The seamless coordination, technical expertise, and commitment to quality demonstrated throughout delivery contributed to establishing Vela by Omniyat as one of Dubai’s most iconic luxury waterfront developments and further reinforced MENASCO’s reputation for delivering engineering excellence on landmark projects.

overview: Qiddiya City is one of Saudi Arabia's flagship giga-projects under Saudi Vision 2030, strategically located approximately 45 km from Riyadh. Spanning more than 360 km² across over 20 distinct districts, the city is being developed as a world-class destination that seamlessly integrates entertainment, sports, culture, tourism, residential communities and business into one connected urban environment.

Designed to become the world's first city built around the "Power of Play," it is planned to feature more than 400 attractions, 12 theme parks, 275 rides, 43 sports facilities and 2,000 public art installations, including the Prince Mohammed bin Salman Stadium, Speed Park Track, a Gaming & Esports District, Aquarabia Water Theme Park and Six Flags Qiddiya City. MENASCO is delivering the MEP scope for the development: engineering, supply, installation, testing and commissioning of HVAC, plumbing and electrical systems.
